title: Accelerating electrically charged ModMax black hole solutions in $F(R)$ gravity
summary: Using the $C-$metric in the context of $F(R)$ gravity coupled with the ModMax nonlinear electromagnetic field (the $F(R)-$ModMax theory), we derive an exact black hole solution in a four-dimensional spacetime. We then examine how various parameters influence the behavior of accelerating ModMax black holes. Treating this black hole as a thermodynamic system, we calculate the Hawking temperature and entropy for the accelerating ModMax black holes within the framework of $F(R)$ gravity.
